baseline_contracts.weighted_median: Static row-G absolute-deviation minimizer,lowest observed tie;independently verify minimum over distinct input values. Do not call it Ge etal fulltemporal algorithm.
baseline_contracts.quadratic: Own exact rational implementation of standard Tikhonov minimizer;uniformpi,chainA=I-L/(2Dmax),Q_alpha=(||y-x||2^2+alpha sum_ij aij||yi-yj||2^2)/n => y=(I+2alpha(I-A))^-1x. Equivalent gamma=alpha/Dmax in unnormalized graphL. Not multidimensional squared-l1 minimizer or TV optimizer.
